question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
-- Build the full report with top sales reps per region (handling ties)
WITH region_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,
        COUNT(o.id) AS order_count,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name
),
rep_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,
        sr.name AS sales_rep_name,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total_sales
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name, sr.name
),
max_rep AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        sales_rep_name,
        rep_total_sales
    FROM rep_totals
    WHERE rep_total_sales = (
        SELECT MAX(rep_total_sales) 
        FROM rep_totals rt2 
        WHERE rt2.region_name = rep_totals.region_name
    )
)
SELECT 
    rs.region_name,
    rs.order_count,
    ROUND(rs.total_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
    mr.sales_rep_name,
    ROUND(mr.rep_total_sales, 2) AS top_rep_sales_amount
FROM region_summary rs
JOIN max_rep mr ON rs.region_name = mr.region_name
ORDER BY rs.region_name, mr.sales_rep_name
